$note: Project config for scripts/conductor.mjs. Everything project-specific lives here — including the board's own location (boardPath) — so the conductor script is reusable across repos unchanged. Absent keys fall back to built-in defaults.

validators.$note: gate[] = reliable/objective validators, run diff-scoped as HARD gates. advisory[] = grep-heuristic validators (noisy on TS: magic-numbers-in-comments, bogus-unreachable) — their findings ANCHOR the LLM review instead of blocking, matching the source system's 'script floor + agent verified pass' design. Promote a validator to gate[] once red-fixture-calibrated.

$holdNote: F2 (RELEASE_TRACKER): trust-core lane needs human-pair review — the conductor never claims these unattended; Brad works them interactively. 2026-07-16: W3-01a un-held for a SUPERVISED build under Brad's explicit authorization (chose 'conductor builds, you gate merge') — conductor runs --no-merge --breakpoint ticket, PARKS the branch (never auto-merges), and Brad reviews the diff + red fixtures and authorizes the merge himself. W3-01b/c stay held until their deps merge, then get the same one-at-a-time supervised treatment.
$gatesNote: 2026-07-15: board validators added to the per-ticket gate — an agent's plan.json/notes edits must keep the citation graph green (caught W3-10 hallucinating docs/MODULE_DESIGN.md only on manual re-run; now automatic).

$modelsNote: W9-12: per-role model routing used to live in a separate scripts/models.json, read unconditionally at module scope in conductor.mjs — a repo importing only conductor.mjs + conductor-lib.mjs + this config crashed with a bare ENOENT before --lint or any argument parsing ran (found live importing into Kryptkeeper 2026-07-28).
